hook: Water ice grains form spontaneously around negative ions in a cold lab plasma, with no dust needed.
summary: In a weakly ionized plasma with trace water cooled below about 200 K, ice grains formed without dust seeds and not without ionization. Mass spectrometry showed hydrated negative ions, mainly OH- with water, growing before rapid ice growth. The result is a lab analog, and extension to the mesosphere and protoplanetary disks is an estimate.
title: Nucleation of water ice under weak ionization via clustering on negative ions
